Definition: Beeri, the name of a Hittite and of an Israelite
BiblicalUsage: Beeri means "my well." The name is shared by several bearers: Esau's Hittite father-in-law; The father of Hosea. It turns up in Genesis 26:34 and Hosea 1:1.
TheologicalSignificance: I believe God kept Beeri in the record on purpose, and that is reason enough to know it.
